data.exact_reserve_text: The 2014 and prior underwriting years produced a profit of GBP 25,887k (2013 & prior: loss GBP 34,891k). This profit compares to a forecast profit of GBP 3,667k at 31 December 2015. The result has benefited from better than expected investment income and profits on exchange. In addition, the claims development on the Property, Special Lines and Liability accounts on the older years of account has been better than expected.

data.standardized_narrative: For the 2016 financial year, the syndicate reported a profit of GBP 25.887 million for the 2014 and prior underwriting years, indicating a reserve release. This favorable development was primarily driven by better than expected claims development on the Property, Special Lines, and Liability accounts for older years of account, as well as beneficial investment income and profits on exchange. However, the current year experienced losses due to new catastrophe and large losses, particularly in Property, Special Lines, and Treaty classes, and attritional loss development on Property and Personal Accident & Sickness lines, including natural catastrophe claims from Hurricane Matthew, earthquakes in New Zealand, Taiwan and Japan, Cyclone Winston, and Canadian Wildfires.

data.data_quality_notes: Conflicting information regarding prior year development. Page 7 states a profit of GBP 25.887m for 2014 and prior underwriting years, implying a release. Page 31 states a net deterioration of GBP 6.859m to claims reserves due to adverse developments on the Treaty class. Following prompt's priority rules, the underwriting year result from page 7 is used as the primary source for prior year development.
